info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Telecom Sim Esim Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM eSIM Status API provides endpoints to retrieve the status of both physical SIM cards and eSIMs for telecommunications services. This API is designed for developers and service providers looking to monitor and manage SIM/eSIM statuses within their applications. Typical consumers of this API include network operators and customer support teams needing to check active devices and their current operational states. By integrating with this API, businesses can enhance their service offerings and improve customer experience through timely updates and management of SIM/eSIM resources.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of the eSIM, providing vital information regarding its activation, readiness, and any potential issues.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of an eSIM. This request should include any necessary parameters to fetch the current status of the eSIM, ensuring that the request conforms to the expected JSON structure.

200.description: The request was successful and the eSIM status information is included in the response.
